Format all code using the linter formatter:
```sh
make build_staging
make test_staging
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsTests/YourTestClass/testMethodName
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsDataModelTests
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsServerTests
make test_staging ONLY_TESTING=PocketCastsUtilsTests
```

Swift Package Manager modules: `Modules/DataModel/` (GRDB persistence/models), `Modules/Server/` (protobuf API; depends on DataModel and Utils), `Modules/Utils/` (shared utilities/localization), `Modules/DependencyInjection/` (DI). Main UIKit/SwiftUI app: `podcasts/`; tests: `PocketCastsTests/`; watch app: `Pocket Casts Watch App/`; widgets: `WidgetExtension/`; build tools: `BuildTools/`.

All data operations go through `DataManager.sharedManager`, located at `Modules/DataModel/Sources/PocketCastsDataModel/Public/DataManager.swift`.

Strings: Add to `podcasts/en.lproj/Localizable.strings` with a context/placeholders comment; use generated `L10n` enum. Use snake_case keys (`feature_relevantIdentifier_description`), positional specifiers (`%1$@`, `%2$@`), never string interpolation. Handle plurals manually with separate `_singular`/`_plural` keys.

SwiftLint: use `naturalContentHorizontalAlignment` instead of `.left`/`.right` for RTL; use `.natural` text alignment instead of `.left`. Never use `LocalizedStringKey` in SwiftUI - use `NSLocalizedString` with L10n. When styling Views, use `<REDACTED_USER> private var theme: Theme` and inject `.environmentObject(Theme.sharedTheme)` where the View is used. Use `AppTheme.color(for: .primaryText01, theme: theme)` for themed colors.

Regenerate protobuf after API changes:
```sh
brew install protobuf swift-protobuf  # One-time setup
make update_proto API_PATH=/path/to/pocketcasts-api/api/modules/protobuf/src/main/proto
```
